conn_try_again: Check your network and try again.
err_generic: Something went wrong. Try again; if it keeps happening, open the log under Diagnostics.
err_invalid: The input could not be read. Check the link or file and try again.
err_notfound: Item not found. Refresh the list and try again.
imp_cam_denied_d: The camera is used only to read QR codes. Allow it in the app settings or pick an image with a QR code.
imp_cam_none_d: This device has no camera. Pick an image with a QR code or paste the link.
imp_fileHint_phone: Choose a file: YAML, base64 or a list of links.
imp_file_unreadable: Could not read the file. Choose another one.
imp_prev_doc: A file or text with a list of profiles
imp_qr_aim: Point the camera at a QR code
imp_qr_hint: Point the camera at a QR code or pick an image that has one. The link from the code opens in the preview.
imp_unrecognized: This is not a link or a profile list. Paste a link such as vless://… or a subscription address.
notif_permission_text: Open the app to allow the VPN again.
stub_soon: This section is still in development.
